name: Raw Meat Platter
ingredients: 1 cup (about 1 lb.) lean lamb, ground twice
instructions: Use lamb only (leg preferred) and serve the same day it is ground.
Salt the meat and blend together.
Add Bulgor wheat, chopped onions, and a tablespoon each of green pepper, parsley, green onions, and cayenne pepper if desired.
Knead all together like dough, adding water a little at a time until meat and Bulgor stick together, forming a smooth mixture (knead about 10 minutes).
Shape into 2 inch patties and serve at once.
Garnish with the rest of the chopped vegetables, after salting them to your taste.

name: Bulgor Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground fresh or left-over meat or sausage
1 cup meat or chicken stock or canned bouillon
instructions: Blend together Bulgor, meat or sausage, one cup bouillon or meat stock, salt, seasoned salt, Worcestershire sauce, and pepper.
Cut peppers in halves lengthwise, remove all seeds and white portions.
Fill pepper halves with Bulgor mixture and place in shallow baking dish.
Mix tomato purée and 3/4 cup meat stock and pour over stuffed peppers.
Cover and bake in moderately hot oven, 375°F, 30 minutes.
Remove cover and continue baking for 40 minutes.

name: Bulgor Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Turn into loaf pan or shape into loaf in shallow baking dish.
If you wish, spread surface with thin layer of ketchup.
Bake in moderate oven, 325°F, about 1 hour or until browned.

name: Bulgor Salmon Loaf
instructions: Blend all ingredients.
Turn into loaf pan and bake in moderate oven, 350°F, 3/4 to 1 hour.

name: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Soften the cabbage leaves in boiling water and cut off the ribs.
Put leaves in boiling water and boil 4 to 5 minutes. Take out, rinse with cold water, and squeeze water out gently.
Add Bulgor to the meat and mix. Add parsley, mint, chopped onions, tomato paste, salt and pepper and blend together.
Spread a leaf on a small plate wrong side up and stem end towards you.
Put some filling near the stem end, fold over the sides, then start rolling from the stem up like a cigarette.
Cover bottom of pan with some leaves, then arrange the stuffed rolls side by side.
Fill with meat broth or water (about 3 cups, or inch below the surface).
Add juice of 1/2 lemon to the water.
Put on the lid and cook or bake with moderate heat for 1 hour.

name: Fish and Bulgor Pilaf
ingredients: 1 pound fresh salmon, cut in cubes or strips
instructions: Heat butter or margarine in skillet, add onion and celery. Sauté until onions are straw-coloured.
Add rest of the ingredients, cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.
